shaken.name: Shaken
shaken.desc: Shaken characters may only take free actions (such as moving up to their Pace). At the beginning of each turn, they must make a Spirit roll to recover. On a success, they are no longer Shaken and may act normally; on a failure, they remain Shaken. Spending 1 Benny immediately removes Shaken at any time.

distracted.name: Distracted
distracted.desc: The character suffers a -2 penalty to all Trait rolls (attributes and skills) until the end of their next turn.

vulnerable.name: Vulnerable
vulnerable.desc: Actions and attacks targeting the character receive a +2 bonus to their rolls until the end of the target's next turn. Does not directly affect Toughness.

entangled.name: Entangled
entangled.desc: The character cannot move and is Distracted while Entangled. They may attempt to break free with a Strength or Athletics roll as an action.

bound.name: Bound
bound.desc: The character cannot move, is both Distracted and Vulnerable, and may only attempt to break free via an opposed Strength or Athletics roll at -2.

stunned.name: Stunned
stunned.desc: The character falls prone, is Distracted and Vulnerable, cannot move or take actions, and attackers gain The Drop if they cannot defend. Must make a Vigor roll at the start of their turn to recover.

incapacitated.name: Incapacitated
incapacitated.desc: The character has suffered Wounds beyond their maximum limit and is out of combat, unconscious, dying, or severely incapacitated. Must immediately make a Vigor roll to avoid Bleeding Out.

blind.name: Blind
blind.desc: Suffers a -6 penalty to all tasks relying on vision and cannot perform direct visual actions.

prone.name: Prone
prone.desc: Ranged attacks against the character suffer a -2 penalty. Melee attacks against them gain a +2 bonus. Standing up costs 2 inches/grid units of Pace.
